newsitem.title: USA: Sun Bancorp acquires three bank branches.
newsitem.headline: Sun Bancorp acquires three bank branches.

text.p: Sun Bancorp Inc said Monday it has completed the acquisition of three branch offices from Oritani Savings Bank of Hackensack.
Terms were not disclosed. The branches are Clementon, Lindenwold and Merchantville, N.J., and have combined total deposits of about $34 million.
"Sun plans to increase the number of deposit and loan products offered to our customers in these branches," Sun National Bank President and Chief Executive Philip Koebig said in a statement.
